methods.name: Start
methods.expectedEffect: Tick is raised every Interval milliseconds.

methods.name: Stop
methods.expectedEffect: No more Tick events are raised until Start() is called again.

methods.name: RunWorkerAsync
methods.description: Starts the background operation and raises DoWork on a background thread.

parameters.name: argument
parameters.description: A value passed to DoWork as e.Argument (the overload without a parameter passes null).

methods.expectedEffect: DoWork starts while the user interface stays responsive. Starting it twice at once throws, so check IsBusy.

methods.name: CancelAsync
methods.description: Requests cancellation. DoWork must check CancellationPending to stop.
methods.expectedEffect: CancellationPending becomes true; the work stops when DoWork notices it.

methods.name: ReportProgress
methods.description: Raises ProgressChanged on the UI thread. Call it from DoWork.

parameters.name: userState
parameters.description: Any extra information, available as e.UserState.

methods.expectedEffect: The progress bar and label can be updated safely in ProgressChanged.

methods.name: ShowBalloonTip
methods.signature: void ShowBalloonTip(int timeout, string tipTitle, string tipText, ToolTipIcon tipIcon)
methods.description: Shows a balloon notification above the tray icon.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Suggested time in milliseconds (Windows may ignore it).

methods.expectedEffect: A notification appears near the clock (unless Windows is hiding notifications).
